# dsh-agentic-pet
English | 中文
## Summary
`dsh-agentic-pet` is a desktop-pet plugin for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem: the pet lives on your
desktop as a transparent always-on-top window, follows your agent sessions (idle / thinking / workin
g / error), races the web GUI to answer approvals and user questions (first answer wins), collects a
per-pet touch-affection ledger, and exposes expressive tools (`pet_say`, `pet_do`, `pet_digest`, `p
et_interactions`, `pet_state`) so the model can speak and act through the pet. Spoken lines can be r
ead aloud through BreezeBlue TTS — the carrier synthesizes each `/say` text and delivers bubble and
voice as one event; synthesis failure or timeout degrades to visual-only (configure it in the deskto
p settings page). Multiple pet implementations can run side by side — a directory registry (`~/.dsh/
pet-http.d/`) discovers every live pet and routes state, interactions, and ledgers per pet.
The pet itself is a dumb display with zero dsh knowledge. Everything that understands the runtime —
event convergence, interaction waterfalls, multi-pet routing, the model tools — lives in the plugin'
s driver, and the pet only implements a small local HTTP control interface. Any pet implementation t
hat speaks the same HTTP contract can be adopted without changing this plugin.
## What's in this repo
| Path | What it is |
| `src/` | The plugin (Cordis bundle): `/pet` route, event driver, registry, `PetService` seam, mode

l tools, settings-page routes |
| `client/` | The desktop sidebar settings page (client half) |
| `c
arrier/` | The Electron carrier **build artifacts** shipped with the package (`lib/`, `dist-renderer

/`) |
| `carrier-src/` | The carrier **sources** (mirrored from the dev upstream; media assets live

in dsh-pet-assets) |
| `vendor/typert-plugin/` | Vendored typert decorator plugin used by the packag

ing config |
| `tests/` | Vitest specs (pure-function coverage of the registry routing and the `/sta
tus` field-matrix normalization) |

## Development
The TypeScript build still runs inside the dsh monorepo workspace (the bundled `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`
deps are not published to npm). The flow:
1. In the monorepo: `pnpm run build` (plugin `lib/`) and `pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-pet run bui

ld` (carrier `lib/` + `dist-renderer/`).
2. Here: `scripts\sync-from-monorepo.cmd` — mirrors sources

and build outputs into this repo.
3. Commit here, then publish from here (see Releasing; the assets
package goes first, manual in dsh-pet-assets/PUBLISH.md).
Tests: `npx vitest run tests/registry-service.spec.ts` runs self-contained (needs only `cordis` and
`vitest`); the full suite including `tests/pet-app.spec.ts` runs in the monorepo workspace.
## Releasing
`package.json`'s `version` is owned by this repo: `scripts\sync-from-monorepo.cmd` mirrors every oth
er manifest field and keeps it. The monorepo copy carries the workspace version (`0.2.1-rc.3`), so a
plain mirror copy used to rewrite the published number — which is why npm `0.4.0` had no commit and
no tag carrying it.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The script refuses to publish unless the working tree is clean, the version exceeds the current one,
tag `v<version>` is absent, the build artifacts are present, and `lib/` carries exactly one bundle
chunk (`tsdown` runs with `clean:false`, so a stale `service-*.js` would ship). A failed publish res
tores `package.json`, so the tree never claims a version that did not ship. A prerelease version (`x
.y.z-rc.N`) publishes under `--tag rc`.
Every published version is reachable as tag `v<version>` — the tag, not the manifest, is what answer
s "what is on npm". Version in the tree therefore always equals the last *published* version.

e in the repo wiki and the project's engineering docs.
